benefits.name: Annual travel credit
benefits.merchant_scope: Travel purchases including airlines, hotels, car rentals, cruises, travel agencies, transit, tolls and parking
benefits.notes: Applies automatically against travel charges. Chase resets it at the close of the first statement after the account anniversary rather than on the anniversary itself, so the real reset can be a few weeks later than shown here. Accounts opened before 2017-05-21 are on a legacy calendar-year reset.

benefits.name: Exclusive Tables dining credit
benefits.merchant_scope: Restaurants in the Sapphire Reserve Exclusive Tables programme
benefits.notes: Up to $150 from January through June and again from July through December, for $300 per calendar year.

benefits.name: The Edit hotel credit
benefits.merchant_scope: Prepaid stays of two nights or more booked with The Edit by Chase Travel
benefits.notes: Two credits of up to $250 each, capped at $500 per calendar year. From 2026 they are usable any time in the year rather than split across two six-month windows, so this is modelled as one annual credit with a per-booking cap noted here rather than as a semiannual benefit.

benefits.name: StubHub and viagogo credit
benefits.notes: TODO: confirm on the issuer page whether this is split into semiannual windows like the dining credit before relying on the reset period.

benefits.name: Lyft in-app credit
benefits.notes: Up to $10 monthly, for $120 a year. The card must be set as the payment method in Lyft.

benefits.name: Global Entry, TSA PreCheck or NEXUS credit
benefits.merchant_scope: Global Entry, TSA PreCheck or NEXUS application fee

benefits.name: Priority Pass Select membership
benefits.notes: Lounge access after activation. No dollar value is tracked.

benefits.name: IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite status
benefits.notes: Complimentary elite status while the card is open. No dollar value is tracked.
